column.loading.description: In place of a timeline's posts while its first ones are being fetched.

column.loading_more.description: Under the posts of a timeline while the older ones after them are being fetched.

column.failed.defaultMessage: The posts could not be loaded.
column.failed.description: In place of a timeline's posts when fetching its first ones failed; a retry action follows it.

column.failed_more.defaultMessage: More posts could not be loaded.
column.failed_more.description: Under the posts of a timeline when fetching the older ones after them failed; a retry action follows it.

column.retry.description: The action after a failure to load a timeline's posts, its first ones or more of them, which fetches them again.

column.empty.description: In place of a timeline's posts when it has none.
